key_points: Boeing/GE Aerospace involvement in the $17B Asia deals, including a $12B aircraft sale, is the most relevant positive catalyst.
The headline suggests incremental aerospace demand and potentially stronger long-cycle aftermarket exposure for GE Aerospace.
Insider option exercise/sale and modest ETF outflows are small, likely noise-level signals.
Most GE Vernova and GE HealthCare headlines are not direct catalysts for GE Aerospace.
Overall impact is mildly positive but not thesis-changing without more detail on GE’s specific content, timing, and margin contribution.
